Deck of Pain III (Patch 3)
By u/PlayDoPain
SIR
  • Shuffles the deck & lays out implements
  • Draws 3 cards each round for Punishment
  • New Game+: Punishment draw +1
BOY
  • Hand starts with 3 cards, +1 each round
  • May counter with up to 3 cards for Mercy
  • New Game+: keeps his Hand

Sir chooses whichever implement he pleases for each round's Punishment. Joker is wild in Boy's Hand (completes any Pair, Flush, Straight, or Three of a Kind). Privilege is negotiated before the session (e.g., a kiss, a rub, or a request). Discarded cards stay out of play until Sir calls New Game+. Multiplayer: Punishment applies to every Boy. Boys may counter individually or pool cards for a joint Mercy Hand; identical tiers don't stack across Boys.
